text:
```yaml
name: E2E Windows

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e-windows:
    name: E2E Windows (Non-Interactive)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Install mise
        uses: jdx/mise-action@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: mise install

      - name: Build CLI
        run: mise run build

      - name: Run E2E tests (Non-Interactive)
        run: mise run test:e2e
        env:
          # Ensure interactive tests are skipped by environment or internal logic
          # The request states StartSession returns nil on Windows, causing auto-skip
          CI: true

      - name: Notify Slack on Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1.26.0
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "text": "Windows E2E tests failed for ${{ github.repository }}\nCommit: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}\nWorkflow: ${{ github.workflow }}\nRun: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
